plainTranslation: Their Saturn in your 4th house brings weight to home, family, and emotional roots. They may help you build a stable foundation, or they may make your private self feel judged. The difference is whether structure comes with warmth.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
